title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery New England files for review and approval a 365-Day Firm transportation Service Agreement with MATEP, LLC.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: Revised copy of a letter which was sent on March 30, 2005. The original letter was inadvertently submitted whith a service date commencing 2002 instead of te correct year of 2005. By Thomas P. ONeill. GC02-05

The Department Approves the proposed Agreement. The Department finds that the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: James Connelly, Chairman; Commissioners W. Robert Keating, Paul B. Vasington, Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr., and Deirdre K. Mannning. (GC 02-05)
